programmes.d: The Sontarans attempt to take full control of Gallifrey.
A dangerous game of hide and seek begins inside the TARDIS when the Sontarans get in.
The Guardian of Time gives the Doctor a difficult task - and a new assistant.
Garron tries to trick the Graff Vynda-K into buying the planet Ribos.
The Doctor and Romana are taken prisoner by the Graff Vynda-K.
The Doctor and Romana are pursued by the Graff and attacked by the ferocious Shrivenzale.
The Doctor faces new dangers when searching for the second segment to the Key of Time.
Romana has been seized by the Captain and the Doctor attempts to rescue her.
The Doctor and Romana attempt to attack the Captain with the help of the Mentiads.
The Doctor risks destroying the TARDIS as he tries to defeat the Captain and Queen Xania.
The Doctor's search for the third segment of the Key to Time takes him to a stone circle.
The stones from the ancient stone circle are alive and have a taste for human blood.
As the Ogri close in, the Doctor attempts to rescue Romana from hyperspace.
When the Doctor releases two alien justice machines from prison, he gets a death sentence.
Arriving on Tara, Romana is taken prisoner by the scheming Count Grendel.
Count Grendel is determined to become Tara's new monarch. Can the Doctor stop him?
As Romana escapes, the Doctor's life is put in danger by her android duplicate.
The Doctor is determined to prevent Grendel from ruling over the planet Tara.
On the third moon of Delta Magna, the Doctor and Romana are soon caught up in a conflict.
The Doctor arrives in time to save Romana from being sacrificed to the bogus god, Kroll.
With Kroll awake and angry, the Swampies are eager to sacrifice the Doctor.
The Doctor and Romana are appalled that Thawn intends to fire a rocket at Kroll.
The Doctor and Romana arrive on the war-torn planet of Atrios.
The Marshal demands that the Doctor devise the ultimate deterrent against the Zeons.
As the Marshal prepares to launch his attack, the Doctor meets the commander of Zeos.
With Mentalis on a countdown to destruction, the Doctor takes desperate measures.
The Doctor and Romana arrive in the lair of the Shadow, who also seeks the Key to Time.
The Doctor and Romana arrive in the lair of the Shadow, who also seeks the Key to Time.
The TARDIS lands on the old Dalek homeworld of Skaro.
Romana is captured and interrogated by the Daleks whilst the Doctor meets the Movellans.
Davros has awoken from his centuries long slumber and is taken prisoner by the Doctor.
The Doctor discovers that the Daleks need Davros to break the stalemate in their war with the Movellans.
While on holiday in Paris, the Doctor and Romana experience a time distortion.
Scarlioni is planning to steal the Mona Lisa. Yet he has six in his cellar - all genuine.
Count Scarlioni is really Scaroth, last of the Jagaroth.
Scaroth intends to travel back in time to save his own people from destruction.
While under the influence of the evil Mara, Tegan redirects the Tardis to the Mara's former home planet.

The Doctor begins to unravel the legend of the Little Mind's Eye crystal; Tegan remains under the Mara's control as it attempts to regain its hold over the planet Manussa.
Chela takes the Doctor's fears seriously and tells him the snake dancer Dojjen can aid him in defeating the Mara.
The Doctor and the original snake dancer Dojjen work to rid the planet of the malign Mara once and for all, but it has the whole of Manussa in its psychic grip now.
The Doctor and Romana follow a distress signal to the jungle world of Chloris.
The Doctor escapes Adrasta by going into the mine, but there's something lurking inside.
The Doctor makes contact with the creature and realizes that all is not as it seems.
The truth of Adrasta's scheme is revealed, but a terrible retribution is already in motion.
(1/4) A hyperspace accident results in two ships fusing together and releasing a deadly menace.
(2/4) The Doctor and Romana discover that someone is smuggling the dangerous narcotic, Vraxoin.
(3/4) The Mandrels have escaped from the Eden projection and are attacking the passengers.
(4/4) Unless the Doctor and Romana act quickly, the villains will escape justice.
With the TARDIS disabled, the Doctor is powerless to act when Romana is kidnapped.
The Doctor attempts to repair the TARDIS so that he can come to Romana's rescue.
The Doctor and Romana suspect that the Nimon are a small part of a large invasion.
